title: Preparation of N,N-Dialkylcarbamato Lanthanide Complexes by Extraction of Lanthanide Ions from Aqueous Solution into Hydrocarbons

material_class.structural_family: homoleptic N,N-dibutylcarbamate; tetranuclear nuclearity suggested but not established

synthesis.procedure: A heptane solution of dibutylamine (10.5 mL, 62.0 mmol in 50 mL) was saturated with CO2 and added at 0 °C to 20.0 mL of aqueous hydrated neodymium chloride prepared from Nd2O3 (1.04 g, 6.20 mmol Nd). After shaking for a few seconds, the violet organic layer was separated and evaporated at about 1.0×10^-3 Torr. The oily residue was redissolved in heptane and evaporated repeatedly to give a violet solid (3.63 g, 89% yield). Subsequent manipulations were under anhydrous N2 or CO2.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: biphasic extraction; evaporation under reduced pressure
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Organic phase separated and evaporated; heptane redissolution/evaporation repeated twice. Aqueous residue contained about 4% of the neodymium (42 mg Nd2O3).

material_class.structural_family: homoleptic N,N-dibutylcarbamate; presumed polynuclear, possibly tetranuclear

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the same CO2-saturated dibutylamine/heptane extraction used for 1, from aqueous hydrated europium chloride obtained from Eu2O3 (1.063 g, 6.04 mmol Eu) and dibutylamine (10.0 mL, 59.0 mmol) in heptane (50 mL). Product mass 3.55 g (88% yield).
synthesis.vessel_or_method: biphasic extraction followed by repeated evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Organic layer separated and evaporated with repeated heptane dissolution to the neutral carbamate solid.

properties.summary: Room-temperature solid-state photoluminescence of 2 is metal-centered Eu(III) f–f emission. No ligand-to-metal antenna channel is observed; the emission is dominated by 5D0→7F2 near 615 nm and the crystal-field pattern differs from the mononuclear dibenzyl analogue 8.

measurements.name: emission maximum (5D0→7F2)
measurements.conditions: solid sample, room temperature; excitation at 394 nm (7F0→5L6), Figure 4

material_class.structural_family: homoleptic N,N-dibutylcarbamate; tetranuclear nuclearity suggested by mass spectrometry and analogy but not crystallographically established

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the same extraction as 1 from aqueous hydrated terbium chloride obtained from Tb4O7 (1.199 g, 6.41 mmol Tb) and CO2-saturated dibutylamine (11.0 mL, 65.0 mmol) in heptane (50 mL), giving 3.84 g (89% yield).
synthesis.vessel_or_method: biphasic extraction followed by repeated evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Rapid repeated heptane dissolution and evaporation of the organic residue avoids the slower hydrolysis that produces crystalline 4.

material_class.structural_family: carbonato-centered tetranuclear N,N-dibutylcarbamate anion with two dibutylammonium cations

synthesis.procedure: Aqueous hydrated terbium chloride from Tb4O7 (1.200 g, 6.42 mmol Tb) was added to CO2-saturated dibutylamine (11.0 mL, 65.0 mmol) in heptane (50 mL). After shaking a few seconds at 0 °C, the organic layer was separated and evaporated at room temperature. The oily residue was dissolved in anhydrous heptane (50 mL) under N2 and cooled to −30 °C. Crystals were filtered and dried in vacuo (1.06 g, 22% yield). Crystals also form on storing the oily residue about 40 h at room temperature.
synthesis.temperature: 0 °C extraction; crystallization at −30 °C or room temperature
synthesis.time: a few seconds of shaking; about 40 h if crystallized from the stored oil
synthesis.vessel_or_method: biphasic extraction then crystallization from heptane under N2
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Organic phase evaporated; residue dissolved in anhydrous heptane and cooled to −30 °C, or stored about 40 h at room temperature. Crystals dried in vacuo.

properties.summary: Solid 4 shows bright green Tb(III) luminescence populated only through metal-centered f–f excitation. The emission comprises 5D4→7FJ (J = 6, 5, 4, 3) bands whose form is independent of excitation wavelength.

synthesis.procedure: The same aqueous chloride/CO2-saturated dibutylamine extraction in heptane used for the other lanthanides was applied to samarium, using an amine/metal molar ratio above 6 at about 0 °C. Storing the evaporated organic oily residue for about 40 h at room temperature deposited single crystals of 5, obtained similarly to 4. Room-temperature crystallography shows the same orthorhombic Cmca carbonato-centered tetramer. No separate isolated mass or yield is reported.
synthesis.temperature: about 0 °C extraction; crystallization at room temperature
synthesis.time: a few seconds of extraction; about 40 h storage of the oil
synthesis.vessel_or_method: biphasic extraction and slow crystallization of the oily residue
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Organic phase concentrated in vacuo at room temperature and stored about 40 h to give single crystals studied at 298 K.

synthesis.procedure: Single crystals of 6 were obtained similarly to 4 and 5 by applying the heptane extraction of aqueous europium chloride with CO2-saturated dibutylamine and storing the evaporated oily organic residue for about 40 h at room temperature. The quantified europium extraction uses Eu2O3 (1.063 g, 6.04 mmol Eu) and dibutylamine (10.0 mL, 59.0 mmol) in heptane (50 mL). Cell parameters at room temperature are a = 32.7(3), b = 17.64(16), c = 28.2(2) Å. No isolated yield is given.

synthesis.procedure: To 2 (3.603 g, 5.39 mmol) in toluene (50 mL) was added dibenzylamine (4.2 mL, 22 mmol), and the solution was saturated with CO2. After 2 days it was concentrated to about 5 mL. Toluene (20 mL) and dibenzylamine (4.2 mL, 22 mmol) were added, the solution was resaturated with CO2, stirred 3 h, and evaporated; this treatment was repeated three times. Heptane (50 mL) was added, the suspension was stirred 15 h, filtered, and the solid dried in vacuo at room temperature (5.01 g, 71% yield).
synthesis.time: 2 days, then 3 h, then 15 h stirring in heptane
synthesis.vessel_or_method: ligand exchange under CO2 in toluene
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Repeated concentration and resaturation, then precipitation from heptane, filtration, and drying in vacuo.

properties.summary: Despite the aromatic dibenzyl groups, 8 shows no antenna sensitization. Eu(III) emission is populated only by f–f excitation and is dominated by 5D0→7F2 near 615 nm, with a crystal-field pattern distinct from polynuclear 2.

measurements.name: emission maximum (5D0→7F2)
measurements.conditions: solid sample, room temperature; excitation at 394 nm, Figure 4

synthesis.procedure: A suspension of 8 (1.310 g, 1.00 mmol) in toluene (30 mL) was evaporated to dryness at 60 °C under reduced pressure and held in vacuo at 60 °C for about 2 h. Toluene (30 mL) was added and the treatment repeated four times. Heptane (30 mL) was added, the suspension filtered, and the solid dried in vacuo (0.57 g, 65% yield).
synthesis.time: about 2 h per vacuum treatment; repeated four times
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Final suspension in heptane filtered and dried in vacuo.

synthesis.procedure: To 7 (0.919 g, 1.56 mmol Sm) in toluene (10 mL) was added dibenzylamine (5.0 mL, 26.0 mmol). The solution was saturated with CO2, stirred at room temperature for 1 h, and evaporated. The residue was heated in vacuo at 60 °C for about 2 h, toluene (30 mL) was added, and the treatment was repeated four times. Heptane (30 mL) was added, the suspension filtered, and the solid dried in vacuo (0.95 g, 70% yield).
synthesis.time: 1 h stirring, then about 2 h at 60 °C, repeated
synthesis.vessel_or_method: ligand exchange under CO2 followed by vacuum removal of volatiles
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Repeated toluene/vacuum treatment, then heptane suspension filtered and dried in vacuo.
